scenario: Constructed: acute vs chronic, single vs multiple, attenuation, invasion, variant vs neoplasm, clot burden
description: Constructed. Acute vs chronic emboli, a solitary vs multiple nodules (also a major location error: one lobe vs bilateral), ground-glass vs solid attenuation, abutment vs invasion, residual thymus vs thymoma and a small vs large clot burden each change management and are major; a mild vs moderate grade of emphysema is minor; a vessel list that leaves out the per-vessel grades is a major severity error.

pred_finding.text: Acute pulmonary emboli in the right lower lobe segmental arteries.

gt_finding.text: Chronic pulmonary emboli in the right lower lobe segmental arteries, with webs and eccentric wall-adherent thrombus.

pred_finding.text: Solitary 9 mm right lower lobe pulmonary nodule.

gt_finding.text: Multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules, the largest 9 mm in the right lower lobe.

pred_finding.text: 8 mm ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe.

gt_finding.text: 8 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe.

pred_finding.text: Right upper lobe mass abutting the mediastinal pleura.

gt_finding.text: Right upper lobe mass invading the mediastinum.

pred_finding.text: Triangular soft tissue in the anterior mediastinum, likely residual thymus.

gt_finding.text: Anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass, suspicious for thymoma.

pred_finding.text: Pulmonary emboli in the left lower lobe segmental arteries with a large clot burden.

gt_finding.text: Segmental pulmonary emboli in the left lower lobe, small clot burden.

pred_finding.text: Coronary artery calcification in the LAD and RCA.

gt_finding.text: Coronary artery calcium: left main none, LAD mild, circumflex none, RCA mild.

errors.reasoning: acute vs chronic emboli changes anticoagulation
solitary vs multiple nodules: primary vs metastatic work-up
pred places the nodule only in the right lower lobe, gt nodules are bilateral
ground-glass vs solid switches the Fleischner pathway
abutment vs mediastinal invasion changes T stage
a normal variant vs a suspected neoplasm
large vs small clot burden changes risk stratification
pred leaves out the mild grades gt gives for the LAD and RCA
